note: Prioritize using workflows; if no existing workflow is available or a workflow can only complete part of the task, combine builtins and call ExecuteSkill.

builtins.AIDesc: Execute a sequence of browser automation actions. Suitable for scenarios such as login, searching, page reading, screenshot capture, file download, and multi-step page operations.

args.sessionId: Optional session ID. If omitted, a new session is created automatically. Subsequent requests for the same website should reuse it whenever possible.
args.closeSession: Optional. Whether to close the session after execution: true/false. Default: false.
args.includeOutputs: Optional. Whether to return details for each action: true/false. Default: false.
args.actions: Browser action array. Can be passed directly as a JSON array or as a JSON string.

builtins.AIDesc: File operations. Supports search, copy, move, mkdir, rename, batch copy (copy_many), and batch move (move_many).

args.action: search | copy | move | copy_many | move_many | mkdir | rename
args.ext: File extension. Used for search. Default: *.
args.paths: File path array. Used for copy_many/move_many.
args.overwrite: Whether to overwrite: true/false. Default: true.
args.newName: New file name after renaming. Used for rename.

builtins.AIDesc: Email operations. Supports send, search, read, download_attachments, reply, mark_read, and save_eml. When calling ExecuteSkill, pass skillCode=email_task and provide the action and corresponding parameters in arguments. When calling ExecuteSkillForCoze, serialize { skillCode, arguments } and place it in the Json field.
usage: send: Send an email. Common parameters: to, subject, body, attachments, insertImagePaths.
search: Search emails. Common parameters: subjectKeyword, fromKeyword, bodyKeyword, unreadOnly, hasAttachments, maxCount, scanCount, dateFrom, dateTo, daysBack, contextKey.
read: Read the email body. Common parameters: index + contextKey, or mailRef.
download_attachments: Download attachments. Common parameters: index + contextKey, or mailRef + savePath.
reply: Reply to an email. Common parameters: index + contextKey, or mailRef + replyText.
mark_read: Mark an email as read. Common parameters: index + contextKey, or mailRef.
save_eml: Save an email as an eml file. Common parameters: index + contextKey, or mailRef + filePath.

tips: It is recommended to run search first, then use index + contextKey to operate on a specific email.
When the user mentions 'the first email' or 'the second email', prioritize using index and contextKey.
For images embedded in the email body, use insertImagePaths instead of manually writing cid.
When downloading attachments, saving eml files, or sending attachments, the local path must be within the server's allowed directory scope.
